components.name: Chip
components.description: Pressable tag. Pass `selected`, `defaultSelected` or `onSelectedChange` to make it a filter/selection chip (aria-pressed, check icon when on); otherwise it is a plain action chip.

components.name: ChipGroup
components.description: Wraps chips with the 8px gap that keeps taps from landing on a neighbour.

components.name: FilterChip
components.description: Active filter with a remove button. The chip itself is not clickable.

examples.title: size sm
examples.code:
<ChipGroup aria-label="Small chips">
  <Chip size="sm" defaultSelected>
    Today
  </Chip>
  <Chip size="sm" defaultSelected={false}>
    This week
  </Chip>
  <FilterChip size="sm" onRemove={() => {}}>
    Design
  </FilterChip>
</ChipGroup>

examples.title: Filter chips (multi select)
examples.code:
<ChipGroup aria-label="Job filters">
  {JOB_FILTERS.map((filter) => (
    <Chip
      key={filter}
      selected={on.includes(filter)}
      onSelectedChange={(next) =>
        setOn((current) =>
          next
            ? [...current, filter]
            : current.filter((item) => item !== filter)
        )
      }
    >
      {filter}
    </Chip>
  ))}
</ChipGroup>

examples.title: Action chips
examples.code:
<ChipGroup aria-label="Quick actions">
  <Chip icon={<CalendarIcon />}>Add date</Chip>
  <Chip icon={<MapPinIcon />}>Add location</Chip>
  <Chip icon={<PlusIcon />}>New tag</Chip>
</ChipGroup>

examples.title: disabled
examples.code:
<ChipGroup aria-label="Disabled chips">
  <Chip disabled>Archived</Chip>
  <Chip disabled defaultSelected>
    Locked
  </Chip>
</ChipGroup>
